context.description: A subtree run after an untrusted folder task outside it is refused at the start

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of verify-spec-VF6.spec.ts (5 tests, 42 expects; my own run: 5 pass, 0 fail, bun exit 0). Given (release-notes spec, no stored run): the seeded copy loads with no failures, T1.3 after equals [T1.1], the T1.3 subtree plan holds only T1.3 with external [T1.1] (not an outside precondition), and the run aggregate is empty. When: the real TaskCommand.run on the T1.3 folder with the real harness, loader, event store and machine; only the ops and job registry record. Then refused before any work: no job start, harness.live is none, no fact stored, git worktree list unchanged, status.json run refused. Refusal line: the message equals the counted header, the exact R12 line 'R12 T1-release-notes.task/T1.3-markdown-render.task: T1.3 is after T1.1, which is outside this run and not trusted' and the hint; a regex pins the Gherkin template and the folder equals T1.3's path relative to the spec; status reason equals the line. Trust by fold through own plans: four stored-slice cases decide start versus R12 refusal and discriminate a fold from a fact scan (trusted then obligation.stale is refused) and own plan from a fixed plan (the same outside.trusted T1.1 is refused in a whole-spec slice and runs in a T1.3-subtree slice). The ordering across several slices is VF20/VF24 scope. VF6 does not depend on the run supervisor trusting-state defect: it never forwards a trust to a live run.
